title: The FDA Just Added an Eye Warning to Ozempic, Wegovy and Mounjaro. Here's What It Means.
yt_title: New FDA GLP-1 Eye Warning (NAION): What It Means

slides.label: What happened
slides.text: On *Nov 9*, the FDA required a new warning on every *GLP-1* medicine about *NAION*, a rare eye condition.

slides.label: What it is
slides.text: Blood flow to the front of the optic nerve drops. It can cause *sudden, painless vision loss* in one eye.

slides.label: Which drugs
slides.text: *Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus, Mounjaro, Zepbound*, plus Victoza, Saxenda and Trulicity.

slides.label: How rare
slides.text: *6.4* cases per 100,000 person-years on GLP-1s vs *3.8* on placebo or other diabetes drugs. The FDA calls it *rare*.

slides.label: What to do
slides.text: *Don't stop on your own.* Talk to your doctor. Any *sudden vision change* is a same-day emergency.
